data.display_address: The Fairmont Palm Residence North, The Fairmont Palm Residences, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Estate are delighted to introduce to you this Luxurious Upgraded Apartment.

 located on a high floor of the prestigious Fairmont Residences North, Palm Jumeirah. Offering breathtaking full sea views, this property is the perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and exclusivity.

Key Features:-

Prime Location Situated in the iconic Palm Jumeirah, offering unparalleled access to world class amenities and a vibrant lifestyle.

A fantastic opportunity where You will enjoy the  panoramic views of the azure waters and the serene surroundings from an elevated vantage point.

Upgraded Interiors: Tastefully designed with premium finishes and modern upgrades, ensuring a sophisticated living experience.

The Fairmont are renowned for their classical and Spacious Layout.

Generously sized living and dining areas, complemented by large windows that flood the space with natural light.

Wake up to mesmerizing views of the sea, creating a tranquil and serene ambiance.

Luxury Amenities
Access to Fairmont's exclusive facilities, including a private beach, swimming pools, fitness center, and 24/7 concierge services.

Convenient Living
Close proximity to fine dining restaurants, luxury retail outlets, and entertainment options.

This apartment is perfect for those seeking a luxurious lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after locations. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exquisite property your new home.

Contact me today to schedule a viewing and experience the charm of this exceptional residence.
